remarks: Walk to train, shopping, restaurants and parks from the 4 bedroom / 3 bath townhouse renovated to perfection. Enjoy low maintenance living with the feel of a free standing home with back deck and yard, open floorplan and quality details throughout. The gracious entry welcomes you to a fabulous living room and dining room featuring a fireplace with a wall of built-ins and French doors to the back deck for endless entertaining inside and out. The sun filled eat in kitchen has new quartz counters, quartz backsplash, all new stainless steel appliances and a banquette for meals. A 4th bedroom and full bath are currently used as a cozy den on the first floor. Upstairs the fabulous primary suite boasts vaulted ceilings with a balcony, walk in closet and grand spa bath just recently remodeled with soaking tub, large shower, double vanity and radiant heated floors. Two additional bedrooms (one with vaulted ceiling) share a chic renovated bath. Laundry is conveniently located on the second floor. The full unfinished lower level with high ceilings, can be finished for additional space. This special home in Canaan Mews won't last! One of 13 units in the private complex.
